note: Controlled vocabularies of the HuMeta profile. 'eric' lists ERIC Thesaurus descriptors for the term (see crosswalks/eric_descriptor_status.json for verification). Term codes are permanent: never change or reuse a code; deprecate it instead. 'ddi' maps a term to a DDI Alliance controlled vocabulary (cv, code, match). 'fos' is the OECD Fields of Science and Technology code. 'isced' is the ISCED 2011 level. 'rs' is a RightsStatements.org statement.

research_field.label: Research field
research_field.definition: Broad field(s) the study belongs to. Choose all that apply; interdisciplinary studies choose several. Mapped to the OECD Fields of Science and Technology (FOS) used by DataCite.

terms.label: Social sciences (including psychology, communication, economics, sociology)
Humanities (including history, languages and literature, philosophy, religion)
Arts (visual arts, performing arts, music, design, art history)
Other field (e.g., natural sciences, health, engineering)

discipline.label: Discipline or subject area
discipline.definition: Discipline(s) or subject area(s) the study is about. For education studies, the subject taught or learned. Each term carries its OECD Fields of Science (FOS) code.

terms.label: Education (as a subject: policy, foundations, teaching and learning)
Visual arts, design, and art history
Other humanities (e.g., cultural studies, digital humanities)

human_participants.label: Human participants
human_participants.definition: Whether people take part in the study. Decides which population and consent fields apply.

terms.label: Yes: people take part directly (surveys, interviews, observation, tests, creative work)
Indirectly: data are about people who do not take part (records, public online posts)
No: the study uses only texts, artworks, objects, or other non-human sources
A specific community or cultural group
terms.note: Selecting this prompts the CARE questions.

terms.label: Artists, writers, performers, or other creators
Authors of online content (e.g., social media users)

education_level.label: Education level
education_level.definition: Education level(s) of the participants. Levels 0–8 are the UNESCO ISCED 2011 levels of education; the last two options are HuMeta additions outside ISCED.

terms.label: Adult, continuing, or workforce education (not an ISCED level)
Informal or out-of-school learning (not an ISCED level)

undergraduate_level.label: Undergraduate course level
undergraduate_level.definition: For undergraduate studies, the course level(s) involved.

institution_type.label: Institution or organization type
institution_type.definition: Type(s) of institution or organization where the study took place.

terms.label: Four-year college or primarily undergraduate institution
Tribal college or university
terms.note: Selecting this prompts the CARE questions.

locale.label: Locale
locale.definition: Community type where the study took place, using the four NCES locale types. Choose more than one for multi-site studies. For fully online studies, leave blank and use Modality.

modality.label: Instructional modality
modality.definition: How instruction or participation was delivered.

learning_environment.label: Learning environment
learning_environment.definition: The instructional setting in which learning or data collection took place.

terms.label: Small class, seminar, recitation, or discussion section
Field course, field trip, or field site
Community setting, public space, or event

pedagogy.label: Instructional approach
pedagogy.definition: Main instructional approach(es) used or studied (optional).

study_design.label: Study design (evidence type)
study_design.definition: The design that produced the evidence in the resource.

terms.label: Practice-based or creative research (e.g., making artworks, performances, designs)

unit_of_analysis.label: Unit of analysis
unit_of_analysis.definition: The unit the analysis is about. Follows the DDI AnalysisUnit vocabulary (2.1.3).

sampling_procedure.label: Sampling procedure
sampling_procedure.definition: How cases (people, texts, objects, sites) were selected. Follows the DDI SamplingProcedure vocabulary (2.0.2).

terms.label: Total universe / complete enumeration (all eligible cases)
Probability: systematic random (e.g., every nth on a list)
Probability: cluster (e.g., whole classes or schools)
Theoretical sampling (cases chosen as theory develops)

measurement_evidence.label: Measurement evidence
measurement_evidence.definition: Kinds of reliability or validity evidence the resource provides, following the sources of validity evidence in the Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing (AERA, APA, NCME, 2014).

terms.label: Evidence based on relations to other variables
Evidence based on consequences of testing

data_collection_method.label: Data collection method
data_collection_method.definition: How data or sources were gathered. Each term maps to the DDI ModeOfCollection vocabulary (5.0.1).

terms.label: Visual or arts-based methods (e.g., photo elicitation, photovoice, drawing)
Work samples, documents, or artifacts produced by participants (e.g., student work)
Archival research (finding and selecting records in archives or collections)
Assembling a corpus of texts, images, or media (e.g., published works, news)
Web or platform data collection (API, scraping, data donation)
Learning analytics or system log data
Practice-based or creative making (artworks, performances, designs)

analysis_method.label: Analysis method
analysis_method.definition: How the data or sources were analyzed. Covers quantitative, qualitative, interpretive, and computational approaches.

terms.label: Psychometric or measurement modeling (e.g., factor analysis, IRT)
Visual or image analysis (e.g., photographs, artworks, film)
Computational text or media analysis (e.g., text mining, NLP, image recognition)
Case analysis or comparative case study

source_type.label: Source type
source_type.definition: Kinds of sources studied that are not (only) data collected from participants: texts, images, artworks, media, records, objects, and online content. Mapped to DDI GeneralDataFormat and DataSourceType.

terms.label: Texts and documents (books, manuscripts, letters, policies, curricula)
Social media and online platform content

source_rights.label: Rights status of sources
source_rights.definition: Copyright or other rights status of the sources studied. Decides whether copies of sources can be shared. Related to RightsStatements.org statements.

terms.label: Public domain or no known copyright
In copyright, used with permission from rights holders
In copyright, used under an exception such as fair use (copies not shared)
Governed by platform terms of service

human_subjects_review.label: Human-subjects review
human_subjects_review.definition: Status of ethics / IRB review, as reported by the researcher.

terms.label: Determined not to be human-subjects research

consent.label: Participation consent
consent.definition: How participants agreed to take part.

consent_for_sharing.label: Consent for data sharing
consent_for_sharing.definition: What participants (or the approved waiver) allow regarding sharing data beyond the research team.

terms.label: Broad sharing of de-identified data consented
Sharing only under restrictions (e.g., approved researchers, data-use agreement)
No sharing beyond the research team

identifiability.label: Identifiability
identifiability.definition: Identifiability of the data in this resource.

sensitivity_flag.label: Sensitivity flags
sensitivity_flag.definition: Kinds of sensitive information present in the underlying data.

terms.label: Public online content that can be traced to its authors

online_data_practice.label: Online data practices
online_data_practice.definition: How content collected from websites, social media, or other online platforms was handled. Informed by the Association of Internet Researchers' Internet Research: Ethical Guidelines 3.0 (2019).

terms.label: Content was publicly available (no login or membership needed)
Some content is from closed or semi-private spaces (groups, forums, chats needing login)
Collected under the platform's terms of service or a data-access agreement
Consent not sought (public content; ethics review agreed or determined not needed)
Usernames and profile details removed or replaced
Quotes paraphrased or altered so authors cannot be found by searching
Only post IDs or derived data are shared, not the content itself
Content later deleted by its authors is removed from the dataset

access_level.label: Access level
access_level.definition: How the data in or described by this resource can be accessed.

indigenous_data.label: Indigenous data
indigenous_data.definition: Whether the resource contains or derives from data about Indigenous Peoples, nations, communities, lands, territories, or knowledges.

indigenous_governance.label: Indigenous data governance
indigenous_governance.definition: How Indigenous authority to control the data (CARE: Authority to control) is exercised.

terms.label: Data governance agreement with the community or nation
Tribal or Indigenous research review approval
